title: arachniodes holttumii
intro: Arachniodes holttumii, commonly known as the Himalayan lady fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. It is a medicinal plant that has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Arachniodes holttumii are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. Bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoid saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
